title: How to automate your sales pipeline with AI
description: Learn how to automate your sales pipeline with AI across prospecting, research, meetings, outreach, CRM updates, and pipeline reviews.
introduction: Sales work gets fragmented quickly. The CRM has the stage, email has the relationship, meetings hold the commitments, and LinkedIn or a company website may have the signal that changes what you do next. A lot of time goes into rebuilding that context before anyone can make a useful move.

Strawberry is an agentic browser and workspace with built-in AI agents. The agent working alongside you—your companion—can use visible tabs, logged-in tools, meetings, files, connected apps, and the public web. It can remember accepted context and carry it from prospecting through research, conversations, follow-up, and pipeline decisions. You can start with one piece of real work and connect the system as it proves useful.

sections.title: Start with the sales work in front of you

blocks.text: The best starting point depends on what is happening now. Strawberry can use the context already available to recommend a small set of relevant options and help complete one. If another app would materially improve the result, your companion can explain what connecting it would unlock without turning the session into setup.

blocks.text: Treat the first result as a draft you can coach. Correct the sources, qualification bar, tone, detail, or review point before the next run. Do not turn one unusual example into a permanent rule.

sections.title: Find and reach the right customers

blocks.text: The route into new pipeline depends on what you already know. A team entering a market may need to understand the account universe first; another may already have the companies and only need verified contacts or better outreach. Working in the browser, Strawberry can follow evidence across company sites, LinkedIn, niche directories, and logged-in tools, then carry accepted research into the next step.

items: Clarify the market when the segment, territory, or account universe is still uncertain.
Find a small, varied first set of companies and review the evidence behind why each one fits.
Enrich an accepted list with only the contacts and qualification fields the next step requires.
Turn approved research into representative outreach in your voice, keeping enrollment and sending separately reviewable.

blocks.text: An important customer conversation is rarely one task. The useful context starts before the meeting and should still be available when it is time to follow up.

items: Research the account and people when missing evidence could change the conversation.
Turn the relevant relationship, calendar, CRM, email, and web context into a concise meeting brief.
Use the reliable transcript or notes to capture the debrief, follow-up, next actions, and proposed CRM changes.
Create a one-pager, deck, tailored page, or other sales asset when the next customer decision needs more than an email.

blocks.text: Because this work happens in the browser you can see, your companion can open the real sources, use logged-in pages, and let you inspect or redirect the research. The accepted context can continue into the next step without rebuilding the account history in another tool. Reviewing a debrief still does not automatically send a message, share an asset, or change a record.

sections.title: See what needs attention across the pipeline

blocks.text: A useful pipeline review needs more than the stage field. Strawberry can combine the CRM with recent meetings, email activity, commitments, missing information, and fresh account signals, then show stalled deals, neglected follow-ups, concentration, timing, and the actions most likely to move something forward.

rows: The market or territory is still unclear
Map the account universe before treating companies as pipeline.
The target is understood but qualified coverage is thin
Find and calibrate more customers against the accepted criteria.
A deal lacks evidence or a credible next step
Research the account or prepare for the next conversation.
The work happened but the record is stale
Prepare the source-backed CRM changes for review.

blocks.text: The review diagnoses the next workflow; it does not launch broad research, send follow-up, or rewrite the CRM automatically. Around that review, a daily brief can surface the meetings, messages, commitments, and risks that deserve attention, while a status update can turn the accepted picture into a concise view for leadership or the wider team.

items.context: Review pipeline health and turn it into a small, evidence-backed next-action plan.
Review and apply approved CRM changes with the source and target record visible.
See which sales meetings, messages, commitments, risks, and decisions deserve attention today.
Turn the accepted sales picture into a concise update for leadership or the team.

sections.title: Keep the method, not just the result

blocks.text: As you correct real work, your companion can learn the sources you trust, the way you qualify accounts, the tone you use, the CRM fields that matter, and where you want to review changes. A later run can begin with the accepted method instead of a generic template.

items: Share the approved artifact when a teammate only needs this result.
Share the method as a team skill when people need the same sources, judgment, and review points.
Share the companion when the team needs ongoing context across several connected sales workflows.
Create a Routine only after the workflow has a trusted trigger or cadence, clear systems, an expected output, approval behavior, and stop conditions.

blocks.text: Until the method is trusted, keep improving it through actual work. Open the Getting Started with Sales skill when you want Strawberry to help choose the first useful piece.

items.context: Bring a trusted individual workflow into the shared Sales companion so teammates can use and improve it together.
